levels.surface: عبد الملك بن شعيب بن الليث

notes: «حدثني أبي» and «عن جدي» are bare relations: the text does not name the father or grandfather.
«ح» splits two routes that both end at ابن شهاب; «كلاهما عن ابن شهاب» writes the shared tail once (rule 3).
«بمثل حديث يونس عن الزهري، بإسناده» names another transmitter (يونس) for the same saying: a variant. The closing «بإسناده» is read as the isnad of that remark, not added to the shared tail.
